who: claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), wave-1124-sansio lane BASE ADDITIONS
what: The brief called blaze-std clock.rs:97 a Clock trait and treated blaze-int as a crate below everything. clock.rs:97 is a struct (it would implement the new blaze_int::Clock), and blaze-core does not depend on blaze-int, so moving blaze-core's wait::retry::Clock onto it first adds that dependency. Separately: blaze-tar converts a checked archive name with from_utf8(..).unwrap_or(""), a quiet fallback after the check, and blaze-blake3's cpu.rs is a second CPU detector with a static cache, on libc's getauxval, beside the new blaze_sys::cpu.
cost: about twenty minutes of reading to correct the brief's two premises before writing the migration table
cause: briefs written from memory of the tree, not from a grep of it
fix: a brief that names a file:line says what is there (trait, struct, dependency) from a grep made while writing it
